item.title: LangChain Is Dead? 7 AI Agent Frameworks for Programmers in 2026
item.description: "LangChain is dead" resurfaces every few months — yet LangChain the company raised $125M at a $1.25B valuation in October 2025, driven by LangSmith. Why the chain model breaks under real agents, and how to choose among seven AI agent frameworks in 2026.
